ruleDefinitions.name: Important Scheduled Task Deleted/Disabled
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when adversaries stop services or processes by deleting or disabling their respective scheduled tasks in order to conduct data destructive activities Note: Unmapped fields: TaskName

sequences.query: ((event_id = 4699 OR event_id = 4701) AND (TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\SystemRestore\\\\SR.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\BitLocker.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\WindowsBackup\\\\.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\WindowsUpdate\\\\.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\UpdateOrchestrator\\\\Schedule.*") OR TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\ExploitGuard.*"))) AND  NOT ((event_id = 4699 AND user = RGX("\\$$") AND TaskName = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*")))
